name: 5-Night Maafushi Local Island Escape
summary: A budget-friendly 5-night stay on Maafushi, a popular local island in Kaafu Atoll, combining a guesthouse-style hotel stay with a real diving session and a sunset fishing trip.

stages.title: Maafushi
stages.description: Five nights on Maafushi, one of the Maldives' best-known local islands for independent, budget-conscious travel — public beaches, guesthouses, and easy access to reef diving and fishing trips.

items.notes: Arrival transfer, arranged directly through Kaani Beach Hotel.
One single-tank dive, run by Maafushi Dive and Water Sports.
Sunset fishing trip, run by Kaani Hotels.

stages.title: Departure
stages.description: Return transfer to Velana International Airport for your onward flight. No specific return service is tracked in this dataset — arrange the return leg with Kaani Beach Hotel or a local operator on Maafushi.

name: 7-Night Kurumba Resort Escape
summary: Seven nights at Kurumba Maldives, the country's first resort, a short speedboat ride from Velana International Airport, with a PADI Open Water course and a sunset reef fishing trip.

stages.title: Kurumba Maldives
stages.description: Seven nights at Kurumba Maldives on Vihamanaafushi island — one of the shortest resort transfers in the country at around 5 minutes by speedboat.

items.notes: Run by Euro-Divers Kurumba, the resort's onsite dive centre.

stages.title: Departure
stages.description: Return speedboat transfer to Velana International Airport. No specific return service is tracked in this dataset — arrange the return leg with Kurumba Maldives.

name: Maldives Honeymoon Escape — Soneva Fushi
summary: Five nights at the all-inclusive Soneva Fushi in Baa Atoll, reached by shared seaplane, with a guided reef dive through the resort's own dive centre.

stages.title: Soneva Fushi
stages.description: Five all-inclusive nights at Soneva Fushi, Kunfunadhoo island, Baa Atoll — a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve — reached by the resort's own shared seaplane transfer.

items.notes: Seasonal fare — see the transfer route page for current pricing.
Run by Soleni Dive Center, the resort's onsite dive centre.

stages.title: Departure
stages.description: Return seaplane transfer to Velana International Airport. No specific return service is tracked in this dataset — arrange the return leg with Soneva Fushi.

name: Maldives Diving Holiday — Baros
summary: Five nights at Baros Maldives with two real dives — a Discover Scuba Diving session and a fluorescence night dive — through the resort's own long-established dive centre.

stages.title: Baros Maldives
stages.description: Five nights at Baros Maldives, Kaafu Atoll, home to Divers Baros Maldives, a long-established PADI Five Star Gold Palm dive centre.

items.notes: A fluorescence night dive, run by Divers Baros Maldives.

stages.title: Departure
stages.description: Return speedboat transfer to Velana International Airport. No specific return service is tracked in this dataset — arrange the return leg with Baros Maldives.

name: Family Maldives Holiday — Velassaru
summary: Seven nights at Velassaru Maldives with a Discover Scuba Diving session and a big game fishing trip — real activities bookable through the resort's own operators.

stages.title: Velassaru Maldives
stages.description: Seven nights at Velassaru Maldives, Kaafu Atoll. The resort's airport transfer is mandatory and resort-operated (third-party transfers are not permitted).

items.notes: Mandatory resort transfer — flight details required at least 72 hours before arrival.
Run by Immersion Dive Centre, in the resort's own lagoon.

stages.title: Departure
stages.description: Return mandatory speedboat transfer to Velana International Airport. No specific return service is tracked in this dataset — arrange the return leg with Velassaru Maldives.

name: Maldives Fishing & Island Hopping Package
summary: A 4-night trip combining Malé and the local island of Maafushi, connected by the real MTCC public ferry network, with a night fishing trip on Maafushi.

stages.title: Arrival — Malé
stages.description: Arrive at Velana International Airport and take the airport ferry across to Malé for the day before continuing to Maafushi on the afternoon public ferry.

stages.title: Maafushi
stages.description: Three nights on Maafushi, reached by the government-run MTCC public ferry (route 309) from Malé — departs Malé at 15:00, does not run on Fridays.

stages.title: Departure
stages.description: Public ferry back to Malé, then onward to Velana International Airport for departure. The Malé-to-airport leg is not separately tracked in this dataset.
